Valibot schemas and TypeScript types for the c15t consent API. The c15t backend, frontends, and Node.js SDK share them, so requests and responses match on both sides.

c15t is used by [2,100+ sites](https://www.wappalyzer.com/technologies/cookie-compliance/c15t/), including expo.dev, zed.dev, unkey.dev, mintlify.com, and sazabi.com.

## Key Features

- Valibot schemas for consent API requests and responses
- TypeScript types inferred from the same schemas
- No framework dependencies

## Installation

Most apps get this package through `c15t`, `@c15t/backend`, or `@c15t/node-sdk`. Install it directly to validate consent API payloads in your own code:

```bash
pnpm add @c15t/schema
```

## Documentation

See the [documentation](https://c15t.com/docs/self-host/api/node-sdk) for guides, API reference, and examples.

## Security

Do not open a public issue for a security vulnerability. Report it privately through [GitHub's vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/c15t/c15t/security/advisories/new). We examine every valid report.

- Do not share the vulnerability in public forums, issues, or pull requests
- Give the steps to reproduce it and the versions it affects
- Give us time to release a fix before you disclose it
